note: Who trades the roads (D-140). Three classes, each with its own purse: a noble house's caravan is the richest because the house holds the land, a chartered guild sits in the middle, and an independent trader owns exactly one wagon and knows it. cash is what the caravan starts with, and it is spent - a caravan BUYS the load it carries and is paid for it at the far end, so spending power is how much trade a caravan can do per trip. units_min/max cap how many crates it will carry; guards_min/max size the guard party. 'homes' says where its caravans start: 'families' = a town where the house is a name on the rolls, 'guild_hall' = a town with a guild hall, 'any' = anywhere that can trade.
